services.name: BWCA Fishing
services.desc: There’s nothing quite like a shore lunch in the Boundary Waters Canoe Area Wilderness or Canada’s Quetico Park - fresh fish, open flame, a quiet lake. It’s one of the great joys of wilderness travel. But catching that fish takes more than luck - it takes a little planning. We recommend coming prepared to fish for multiple species, as location, depth, and behavior can vary by season and lake. It may sound obvious, but it’s worth repeating: location matters. Too many people start fishing in the middle of a lake - instead, try these proven spots: Tip: Use lake maps (like Fisher or McKenzie) to spot narrow channels, inlets, and structure.
